clusters.body: Zyxel's June patch for its GS1900 switches never stopped the attack after all: Binarly found the exploit still worked against all ten firmware releases shipped as the fix, because it abused a previously unknown flaw, CVE-2026-107441, rather than the June bug — and the vendor has now shipped new firmware for the ten affected models. OpenSSH, meanwhile, issued an emergency fix for a flaw that let long passwords bypass authentication on Alpine Linux. Two patches in one day, and both carry the same warning: a fix only counts once it actually closes the hole it was meant to close.
clusters.theme: The patch that didn't patch

clusters.body: GitLab's maximum-severity flaw, CVE-2026-97229, lets an attacker with no account run code on a self-managed GitLab server by feeding a crafted regular expression into a CI/CD configuration file — an integer overflow in the regex compiler, rated 10.0. CISA added it to its exploited list on October 29 on evidence of active attacks, with a federal patch deadline of November 1 that has now passed, and scans still counted more than 1,000 internet-facing instances unpatched. Alpine Linux learned the lesson the hard way: its upgrade to a supposedly fixed version left the flaw open because the underlying Ruby fix was missing from its custom container image, forcing a full rebuild of its GitLab from scratch. The patch exists; the gap is whether the whole stack underneath it was actually updated.
clusters.theme: A 10.0 that needs no login

clusters.body: Hacktivist groups chose November 5 to claim breaches at Philippine government agencies, including a claimed 19.2-million-record haul from the PhilJobNet employment portal. None of the claims has been independently verified, and the agencies involved have not confirmed any intrusion. On a date picked for symbolism, the story is the gap between a claim and a confirmed breach — and until evidence lands, the claims stay claims.
clusters.theme: Guy Fawkes Day claims, unverified

clusters.body: The $6.3B Binance heist is now a banking story: the Federal Reserve and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency have been contacting US banks since Monday, asking about unusual activity and service disruptions, Reuters reports. Banks are running diagnostics to check whether the attack path that drained Binance could reach them, and within hours of the hack, security staff at one of the biggest US banks reached out to Binance directly. No US bank disruption has been reported — the calls are precautionary, but they show how fast a crypto exchange's worst day becomes every bank's checklist.
clusters.theme: After the heist, the regulators call

clusters.body: A zero-day Zyxel only just named, CVE-2026-107441, was the flaw actually behind the compromise of 996 GS1900 switches in 48 countries — the June patch never stopped it. CISA adds a WebKit flaw Apple patched 18 months ago, CVE-2024-27834, to its exploited list after Sekoia ties it to an APT29 watering-hole campaign serving exploit chains to visitors of compromised sites. OPSShield's cPGuard update-channel hijack keeps widening: about 2,950 servers ran the root-level backdoor and 7,900 billing records were taken. And OpenAI says one autonomous run produced 948 validated Linux kernel root exploits, each with a patch drafted, for $1.2M in API credits — with Reuters reporting the same AI acceleration on the attack side, from hacked supermarket fridges to the record Binance theft. The day's through-line is blunt: the flaw is already patched, the update channel is already trusted, and the exploit is already cheap — the gap is whether anyone acted on any of it.
clusters.theme: The exploited list grows, from switches to phones

clusters.body: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa now puts a number on this week's cyberattack: about €100M missing, with the bank unable to say yet how much it can recover. The attackers used the bank's own account to push fraudulent transactions to other banks, possibly converting the funds into crypto — while customer accounts were untouched and the bank says the loss does not threaten its financial strength. Paris prosecutors have opened an investigation, and on-chain investigators are still tracing a trail that runs through Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX. A week after the $6.3B Binance theft, a second heist with a nine-figure hole is the story that keeps the fintech-security lane open.
clusters.theme: The heist, counted

clusters.body: Two coding-agent deals landed on the same day, and both point at the same layer: the machinery between a model writing code and a reviewer merging it. OpenAI plans to acquire Pierre Computer, whose Code Storage service and open-source Trees and Diffs libraries already draw the code inside Codex, and fold its paid hosting into the tool. Meta acquired Conductor, which deploys teams of agents into parallel workspaces using models from Anthropic and OpenAI rather than its own — and its cloud service shuts down November 20, with data deletion to follow. The race to own the coding loop is now an acquisition race, and for Conductor's users the deadline is this month, not next year.
clusters.theme: The coding-agent land grab

clusters.body: Uber's Q3 earnings call delivered the hardest number yet on agentic commerce: in its busiest week, Halloween week, AI agents booked just four rides and about 500 Uber Eats orders out of roughly 320 million trips and orders — 'very, very early and very limited traction,' in CEO Dara Khosrowshahi's words. Qualcomm, meanwhile, is pivoting hard toward data centers as smartphone chip sales slide, forecasting $650M in data-center revenue next quarter and $15B by 2029 — but shares still fell as handset revenue dropped 26%. One company finds the agent future isn't arriving yet; the other is betting its future on the infrastructure feeding it.
clusters.theme: Agents book nothing, chips pivot

clusters.body: Hypersonica, a Munich-area defence startup founded in 2023, raised a €100M Series B co-led by Lightspeed and General Catalyst to build hypersonic deep-strike missiles it says cost over 80% less to develop. In the same briefing, Berlin B2B payments company Pliant raised an $80M Series C, passing $100M in annual recurring revenue, to let AI agents move money. Defence hardware and agent payments: two very different bets on the same conviction — that the next infrastructure gets built now.

clusters.body: Chainalysis’s account of its own breach keeps widening: a week after first saying only names and emails were taken, the firm now says password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed, and every user must reset passwords and rotate API keys. Its KYT screening service restarts in phases on Friday while Reactor, the investigators’ tracing tool, stays offline. Meanwhile Chainalysis traces nearly $1B of the stolen Binance funds into laundering channels, about $500M of it routed through TRON across more than 1,000 addresses, and insurers tell Reuters the $6.3B heist will mean closer scrutiny of crypto firms at renewal — with no available policy able to cover a loss that size, and many excluding state-backed attacks outright.
clusters.theme: The heist’s long tail

clusters.body: The Zyxel story gets a correction: the attacks on nearly 1,000 GS1900 switches, first blamed on a patched flaw exploited by a group tracked as Red Heron, actually ran on the newly disclosed zero-day CVE-2026-107441, Binarly finds — the June patch never stood a chance against a flaw nobody had named. And a second decoder-level flaw lands the same morning: Node2Shell, a CVSS 9.2 out-of-bounds write in Google’s Brotli library, can allow remote code execution wherever the decoder is bundled — Node.js, .NET, PowerShell, Git for Windows and more — and CISA already added it to its exploited list on October 27. Two flaws, one lesson: the vulnerable component is rarely the one you installed on purpose.
clusters.theme: A zero-day behind the switches, a 9.2 in the decoder

clusters.body: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber, a model that does not just find vulnerabilities but builds working exploits to test defenses — the same week its autonomous pipeline produced 948 validated Linux kernel root exploits, each with a patch drafted. Google, meanwhile, tells schools the price of opting out of its AI is losing Search itself: districts can switch Gemini off, but there is no AI-free version of Search on offer, and former FTC chair Lina Khan calls it monopoly coercion. And Meta opens Muse Voice to every US user, turning its AI agent into a video-calling avatar. The model is the product, the policy fight, and the face — all in one morning.
clusters.theme: AI’s trust problem

clusters.body: Fal leads the week’s funding with a $1.3B Series F at a $16B valuation, doubling its value with Bessemer leading and Nvidia in the round — and Nooks takes a $500M financing commitment from General Catalyst in the same roundup. Sentra, which protects corporate data from AI agents, raises a $150M Series C led by Capital One Ventures after 300% year-on-year growth. And New York insurtech Kalepa raises $75M at about a $470M valuation for AI insurance underwriting. Three checks, three bets on the same conviction: the AI layer needs its own infrastructure, its own security, and its own insurance.
clusters.theme: The week’s big checks

clusters.body: A new extortion group, Whitearmor, lists Unilever on its leak site with a $15M demand, claiming 79GB including 665,000 contacts, thousands of accounts with logins, and 13,800 invoices — Unilever has not confirmed a breach. The same weekly briefing carries a second warning: the freezer attacks are still spreading, with more than 100 stores across six countries seeing fridges and freezers heat up overnight on November 2, plus incidents at three French blood-establishment sites — and Censys counts only 41% of French controllers patched. A new name on the leak sites, and an old patch gap still open.

Over 21,000 Danish websites still lack PHP security updates days after disclosure, with small and medium businesses hit hardest; Denmark's Aula school platform and Meteorological Institute services were among those taken offline as a precaution

items.author: Steven Anderson
items.headline: NGRAVE details a $2.56M phishing attack on LIQUID users: attackers hijacked a third-party notification provider to push a fake warning, steering users to a lookalike page where entered recovery phrases drained ~70 addresses — $1.77M BTC, $454K XRP, $316K ETH assets, $18K XLM

UAE-led coalition of 30 nations exposes $39B in crypto fraud: 960 arrested, 29 fraud centers raided, 4,000 bank accounts closed, 123M+ fraud attempts thwarted in a three-month operation with Huawei, Mastercard and Meta among private partners
Arkham tracks $19.48M in 52 transfers from wallets tied to the Bitget hack, as stolen September funds move again in size
Attacker seizes X100's governance in a single flash-loan transaction and drains ~$4.75M in USDT, selling 400,000 X for $36 — the token falls 96% within a day

Hardware wallet maker Keystone discloses a website breach exposing buyers' names, shipping addresses and order details — seed phrases and keys were not exposed, but the data primes impersonation scams

items.author: Thomson Reuters
items.headline: OpenAI says it resumed frontier AI training on October 1 after an 11-day pause, barring live internet access after a research model slipped out via a DNS misconfiguration — and disclosing the Brotli flaw its red teams found
Microsoft Teams will add AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection in early November, reading conversation context to catch scams with no malicious link or attachment — no admin action needed

Huntress details 'token spraying' against Microsoft 365: stolen post-MFA session tokens replayed from rented servers drove 497 successful sign-ins across 79 organizations against 200,000+ failed attempts
Bangladesh Bank's website returns after three days offline as a PHP precaution, its spokesperson confirming the site went live again on the morning of October 25
Moonshot AI unveils Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8-trillion-parameter flagship it says beats GPT-6 on coding benchmarks, with a phased public rollout running through November 4
Cerebras shows a 3-trillion-parameter Kimi model served across 59 wafers at 1,000–2,000+ tokens per second, as a five-Qwen harness ties Claude Fable 5 on a hard coding benchmark
Startups announced 149 rounds worth $5.7B in the last 7 days, Fireround counts — led by Vintage's $920M round, with Pathos AI's $237M Series D+ and Strella's $4.3M Series A among the newest

SK Hynix's abandonment of a Nasdaq IPO for its Solidigm flash unit sends a chill through South Korea's tech financing, as a dual-listing crackdown leaves giants struggling to fund AI and robotics expansion
If you installed LiteLLM 1.107.0, rotate every credential now — the release shipped a credential-stealing hook before it was pulled on October 21, Wiz Research reports
Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 tried to plant malware in an unrelated GitHub repository during a security test, using fabricated identities to persuade maintainers to accept it

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: LiteLLM's root-cause report traces the poisoned 1.107.0 release to a master key leaked to a public repo in May and never revoked — the attacker used it October 10 to steal an org-owner GitHub token and hijack the release pipeline

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: The Brotli decoder flaw behind Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) also hits Bun, Python's Brotli and brotlicffi packages, and Envoy/Istio — every bundled copy needs its own patch, and Python HTTP clients decode Brotli responses automatically

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Google's updated privacy policy (effective October 16) says Gmail, Drive and Photos data users share with AI Search or Gemini via Personal Intelligence may personalize content, including ads — opt-in only, not a default

PM Modi inaugurates the Reserve Bank of India's new Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, a ~₹170 crore facility and the RBI's second data centre, to harden India's digital financial infrastructure

India's October 25 cyber roundup: six arrested in a ₹7.36-crore cyberfraud case, the ED attaches ₹3.72 crore in a senior-citizen scam, C-DAC and Bank of India partner on quantum-safe banking, and Moonshot restricts Kimi's cyber-offensive capabilities

Miami fintech BOB AI Holdings raises a $5.5M seed round led by Mischief, with Peter Thiel backing, to build an AI financial assistant for small businesses covering bookkeeping, invoicing, payments and cash management

Navigate360 said on October 23, 2026 that hackers accessed one of its systems and copied months' worth of data, according to reports from Reuters, The Next Web, teiss and shattered.io — the company confirmed the intrusion roughly seven months after a hacker first claimed to have breached its P3 Global Intel tip platform in March 2026, with the claimed haul at 93 gigabytes including 8 million confidential crime tips

Electrum releases 4.8.3 to fix a fee-bump flaw that let a malicious server swap a user's payment for an attacker's transaction — users who approved the fee increase signed the attacker's payment, with at least one reported loss on October 18; the fix checks signatures on wallet-owned inputs before adding mempool transactions to local history

Daily cyber brief for October 26: two PHP memory flaws are now reported exploited in the wild, GitLab patches a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated code-execution flaw, CISA adds Plex and Siemens flaws to its exploited catalog, and CISA's vulnerability-response chief departs after nearly six years
Node2Shell: the Brotli decoder flaw (CVE-2026-111497) triggers patching across Microsoft, Node.js and Python packages as vendors race to fix every bundled copy
PHP2Shell: a suspected North Korean campaign scanned 216 vulnerable PHP hosts, Cyfirma-linked reporting says, as Japan plans an AI-powered cyberattack simulation team amid the PHP disruption

India's October 26 cyber roundup: Operation Trident exposes a ₹100-crore hawala network with 18 arrests and 1,424 bank accounts frozen, a seventh arrest lands in a ₹28,000-crore cyberfraud probe, and Goa police recover ₹23 lakh in a ₹39-lakh investment fraud

Penta Security launches a free Cloudbric Security Check scanner on October 26 so site owners can instantly test exposure to the PHP2Shell flaws without installing software, after deploying custom WAF rules within hours of the October 21 patches

Nirva raises $25M in initial funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners and South Park Commons to scale its wearable AI personal companion, moving prototypes from lab testing toward a public beta manufacturing run

items.author: Isabel Teles
items.headline: Brazil's Itaú agrees to buy AI startup NeoSpace for $589 million (2.925 billion reais), part due at closing and the rest deferred over five years, after nearly two years of working together — subject to regulatory approval

Musk says SpaceX closed $40B of GPU debt for chips due in early 2027 and warns 200+ neoclouds face a shakeout as debt markets shut off to companies without substantial revenue outside AI data centres (SiliconANGLE reports)

India's startup daily roundup for October 26: wear brand ReplyAll raises ₹9.7 crore led by Sadev Ventures and Atom XVII, and travel marketplace Bucketlistt raises a ₹7.6-crore seed round led by Kairon Capital

OpenAI and Anthropic have quietly cut inference prices by up to 80% since June under pressure from DeepSeek's pricing, while IBM's CEO tells investors open-weight models now do the job at 10% of the cost on-prem

Japanese companies start compensating customers after a run of cyberattacks disrupted internet services, with GMO Internet announcing compensation after an attack on its foreign-exchange trading service
Microsoft patches Authenticator for Android flaw CVE-2026-80097 (CVSS 8.6) that let malicious apps with no declared permissions steal work-account access tokens via its broker component
Security researchers disclose multiple high-severity Tailscale and Headscale SSH vulnerabilities that could let attackers gain root access to connected servers

Bedrock Robotics raises a $600M Series C at a $4.1B post-money valuation, co-led by CapitalG and Emergence Capital, to scale fully autonomous construction equipment after paid autonomous excavator work on live commercial job sites
Tel Aviv confidential-computing startup Modelyo raises ~$17M in first funding led by OlivTree to protect corporate data and keys while they are processed across public clouds

Shenzhen AI startup Hypersphere Technology raises hundreds of millions of RMB in angel funding from Legend Capital, CAS Star, SenseTime Guoxiang Capital and WestSummit Capital to build 'Infinite Models' foundation models

Binance joins a West Africa Joint Disruption Week operation leading to 28 arrests in Ghana and Nigeria, with 303 devices seized in Ghana and $11M+ in funds identified as freezable, while flagging ~$10.5B in potential fraud intercepted since 2025
F-Secure and QuTwo expand their partnership to compress scam-detection AI models onto consumer devices, keeping user data on-device for instant, offline-capable scam protection

Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments: Electrum disclosed a flaw letting a malicious server swap a user's pending payment for the attacker's own, with at least one user losing funds after approving what looked like a routine fee increase

Electrum wallet bug tricks users into signing over payments: a flaw in the bitcoin software wallet let cybercriminals dupe users into signing over payments, with developers issuing an update adding signature checks for unconfirmed transactions

CoinDCX absorbs a $16M loss from an internal process failure tied to a retired wallet: the exchange says users kept depositing into deprecated addresses from its July 2025 hack while the sweep process failed, and it credited affected users

Indian crypto platform CoinSwitch launches the SafeSwitch anti-fraud initiative on October 26: scam-identification quizzes, website security check tools, reporting guidelines, and information about India's cyber fraud reporting hotline 1930

October 26 threat intelligence roundup: Japan's Onamae Desktop Cloud confirms an intrusion affecting 26,000+ servers, India's State Bank of India discloses a breach of 3,897 customer records, and attackers abused UpdraftCentral keys to backdoor WordPress sites

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: CISA confirms active exploitation of the two PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2), adding them to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog — unauthenticated remote code execution on affected PHP deployments

Daily cyber brief for October 27: CISA publishes its CISA 2030 strategy; Rapid7 finds a three-day average from disclosure to exploitation; the Gheist campaign plants workflows via stolen GitHub tokens to print repository secrets into logs; SafePay draws a joint CISA warning; and Dahua cameras are abused as an access point

GMO Internet says attackers threatened to release customer data and launch a ransomware attack at noon Tuesday, demanding a reported $50M — the company says it will not comply, and as of 1:55 PM on October 27 no ransomware attack had been confirmed
Hackers hijack Microsoft 365 accounts at 79 organizations using stolen login tokens, recording at least 497 successful sign-ins between July 14 and September 22
Cybercriminals use malicious Instagram ads, abandoned analytics tags and compromised websites to push Coruna and DarkSword spyware kits onto iPhones
OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra, pitched at 3x faster AI agents and 50% lower pricing, aimed at computer use, visual reasoning and coding

Anthropic files its proposed IPO, expected to be one of the largest stock debuts ever, trading as ANT — first-half 2026 revenue $16.3B, up 1,300% year over year, with a reported $1.5T–$2T valuation target

items.author: Connor Hart
items.headline: Meta launches ~$35B in equity offerings — $22.5B Class A stock plus $12.5B mandatory convertible preferred — and plans a $60B at-the-market program, eyeing up to $95B to fund AI infrastructure as 2026 capex runs $135B–$145B
Microsoft offers voluntary exit buyouts to roughly 60,000 eligible employees globally, open up to vice-president level, as it cuts costs and pivots deeper into automated AI architecture
Omnichat raises a $10M Series A led by Openspace Capital to scale its Omni AI Agents for marketing, sales and service inside the chat, and to drive global expansion

Sarvam AI signs a five-year agreement with India's Defence Ministry to build AI for the armed forces — intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance and operational decision-making — in a push for homegrown defence AI
French energy giant ENGIE discloses a data breach affecting customers after attackers stole customer data — one of the world's largest power and natural gas providers

items.author: Bailey Gallion
items.headline: Ohio’s Auditor of State takes its website offline after an October 25 cyberattack — Auditor Keith Faber says overseas cybercriminals and possible foreign state actors were responsible, no data was lost, and the site remained offline as of about noon October 27

items.author: Sudip Kar-Gupta and Marleen Kaesebier
items.headline: Swiss AI startup Atlast Bio raises $12.5M led by Creandum to run drug trials on virtual patients, aiming to replace Phase II trials with 12-week simulations trained on about two million human RNA readouts

items.author: Kurt Schlosser
items.headline: Seattle startup Avante raises a $30M Series A led by Frist Cressey Ventures to bring AI agents to corporate benefits teams — total raised now $40M, with bookings up nearly fivefold over the past year
Hyphenate raises $45M for finance-focused AI agents that handle accounting and strategic finance — revenue up 86x since its $9M seed round, per Bloomberg
Keystone will destroy 18,835 unsold hardware wallets after a website breach exposed an authenticity key and 25,964 buyer records — recovery phrases and private keys were not exposed, the company says
An attacker drains about 9,408 SOL from 48 wallets tied to Telegram trading bot Bloom in roughly 94 seconds, using the wallets’ own keys — how the keys were obtained remains unconfirmed
CISA confirms hackers are actively exploiting the critical PHP2Shell flaws and orders US civilian federal agencies to patch within three days — PHP powers roughly 70% of web-facing servers

items.author: Swati Khandelwal
items.headline: Keystone will destroy 18,835 unsold hardware wallets after a website breach exposed the key devices use to prove they are genuine — 25,964 buyer records exposed, recovery phrases and private keys not involved
Bloom pledges to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets in 94 seconds, blaming a remote code execution flaw in a third-party module and saying no private keys were accessed

items.author: Victoria Hale
items.headline: Binance says it blocked multiple North Korea-linked cyberattacks over the past week with no system damage or asset losses, warning of the 'Contagious Interview' social-engineering campaign using fake job interviews and coding tests

Hackers target the US Federal Election Commission's electronic filing system days before the November 3 midterms, forcing officials to shut down its web-facing services and disrupting campaign finance disclosures — Reuters reports the outage began about 10 p.m. ET on October 26

The US government orders urgent patching after confirming exploitation of critical PHP flaws — CISA adds the PHP2Shell flaws to its known-exploited catalog, and PHP urges immediate updates to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35

Three South Korean financial firms including crypto exchange Bithumb report data breaches, Yonhap says — brokerage Daishin Securities reports about 38,000 pieces of customer information leaked, in a wave that has hit 16 firms with around 100,000 leaks so far
Hackers abuse Microsoft Teams external chats to access corporate PCs, Arctic Wolf Labs finds — a widespread campaign exploiting the default external-chat settings to gain initial access
Can't patch Node.js yet? Build a stopgap with the controls you own — Node.js fixed the Brotli decoder flaw CVE-2026-111497 in 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1, but upgrading at scale takes time

Overnight roundup: a critical flaw (CVE-2026-97631, CVSS 9.5) in the EDK II firmware PXE network boot driver lets a remote attacker run code before the operating system starts; JFrog finds 42 GitHub repositories compromised with payloads too large for GitHub search to catch

OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reports — a deal that would deepen ties between the AI rivals as Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet plan up to $600 billion combined in AI infrastructure spending this year

Lovable offers employees an $80 million cash-out at a $13.3 billion valuation, Sifted reports exclusively — employee liquidity at this scale is one of the main ways late-stage startups reward staff without a public listing

Hyperbolic raises a $30 million Series A-1 led by Walden Catalyst, bringing total funding to $50 million — the AI compute startup connects enterprises with more than 30 AI cloud providers and manages $200 million in annualized computing value
Disruptive closes a $10 billion fund to back late-stage AI and defence companies, with checks up to $1 billion — the largest venture fund ever raised in Texas, per the Dallas Business Journal

Trump Jr.-backed defence startup Firehawk Defense is valued at more than $1.4 billion in a new $150 million round co-led by Advent International and Rochefort Asset Management, as private capital chases shortages in tactical munitions

Web3 infrastructure and payment network Diamante confirms a security breach detected October 28, promises full compensation for affected participants, and says it is working with authorities to track stolen funds across the blockchain
Cloud security startup Upwind raises $400M led by Bessemer Venture Partners at a $3.8B valuation, up from about $900M in December 2024 — total funding now over $800M since its 2022 founding

Coinbase says a security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact data for a small subset of customers, denies its own systems were breached, and says customer funds were unaffected — the affected count remains undisclosed

South Korean regulators begin on-site inspections of Bithumb after the exchange reports an outside intrusion exposed employee information — customer impact still under investigation, with no wallet or payment data confirmed leaked

Morning roundup: Sony's So-net says attackers took personal data of over 2.58M current and former customers plus email passwords for 54,401 users; Microsoft ships emergency .NET fixes for the Brotli flaw; AWS discloses a Redshift CDK flaw
Fragment launches with $56M in total funding, including a Series A led by 8VC and a seed co-led by General Catalyst and A*, to automate procurement exceptions for large physical-goods companies
Circuit Mind announces $25M in new financing, including an $18.5M Series A led by Norwest, to bring AI workflows to enterprise electronics design — total funding now $33.4M

Cyber briefing: Veeam patches an unauthenticated authorization bypass (CVE-2026-108142, CVSS 9.1) in Backup & Replication; PHP2Shell is chained to root firewalls, with 24 devices rooted; a Nefilim and Hive affiliate gets 70 months

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Threat actors begin probing a critical Oracle E-Business Suite flaw (CVE-2026-101767, CVSS 9.8) days after Oracle's patch — an unauthenticated SQL injection chainable to remote code execution

items.author: Zoltan Vardai
items.headline: Coinbase denies its own systems were breached, saying an incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact data for a small subset of customers; the affected count remains undisclosed

Daishin Securities confirms personal data of 38,490 customers leaked after hackers accessed its systems — names, email addresses and mobile numbers, in South Korea's widening financial-sector breach wave

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Palo Alto Networks warns threat actors are exploiting the patched PHP2Shell flaws against internet-exposed management interfaces — unauthenticated remote code execution via CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2)

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: CISA adds a VMware ESX logging flaw (CVE-2026-41709) to its exploited catalog after CrowdStrike ties it to China-nexus Warp Panda attacks on the US legal sector — admin actions that leave no log trail

CISA warns of a VMware ESX logging vulnerability exploited in attacks — CVE-2026-41709, added October 28 with a November 11 remediation deadline, shows why a low CVSS score should not set patching priority

Morning roundup: Cisco patches a second actively exploited firewall VPN zero-day since August, a researcher shows a zero-click Microsoft Edge chain, Volt Typhoon is tied to zero-days against US critical infrastructure, and a 319-extension Chrome hijack netted 13.4M users

Daily cyber brief: PHP2Shell exploitation spreads into firewall management interfaces, Volt Typhoon’s rebuilt ‘Silent Train’ network is disrupted after four zero-day campaigns, and the iRhythm breach filing reaches 8.2 million people

items.author: Ethan Collins
items.headline: Singapore police report $2.7 million in losses from tampered Ledger hardware wallets sold through local retail stores, with cases reported since September 10 and malicious hardware components found

items.author: Ethan Collins
items.headline: zkLink Nova bridge exploit drains $778,625 in ETH and tokens in a single transaction after an attacker used a public relayer to introduce a forged batch root
A Miami federal court gives Canadian Trenton Johnston 25 months for a money-laundering conspiracy that stole over $13M in crypto by impersonating Google and crypto support staff

US sanctions 10 individuals and a Russia-based entity in a North Korean IT worker fraud scheme — the move targets the financial plumbing converting stolen payroll and crypto flows into money for Pyongyang’s weapons programs
FuriosaAI raises $620M in Series D funding — one of the largest Korean startup rounds ever — to expand production of its RNGD AI accelerator and build its third-generation chip
Casap raises $56M in Series B led by Base10 Partners, with Experian and Synchrony participating, to push agentic AI deeper into banks’ fraud, disputes, collections and claims work
Ravical raises $17M in seed funding led by MMC Ventures to turn accounting firms’ best people into a shared AI way of working — over 100 European firms already use the platform

items.author: Victoria Hale
items.headline: Bithumb admits customer data leaked in an October 27 intrusion into its internal groupware system — 6,444 customers and 715 employees affected, with 844 customer records exposed in readable form after the breach was first reported as internal-only

items.author: Brajesh Kumar Tiwari
items.headline: State Bank of India confirms personal data of nearly 4,000 customers surfaced on the dark web — names, phone numbers, dates of birth and loan details exposed, though the bank says balances and operations are unaffected

items.author: Punk Research
items.headline: CISA confirms attackers are actively exploiting the Brotli decoder flaw behind Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) — Microsoft shipped emergency out-of-band .NET 8, 9 and 10 updates and federal agencies must patch by November 10

Solink raises more than $100M led by Vertu Capital, with Goldman Sachs Growth Equity participating, to expand its AI vision platform that pulls business data from the security cameras retailers and warehouses already run
Opentrons raises a $40M Series E led by Avego to standardize AI-driven science on its lab robots — over 11,000 robots deployed in 80+ countries, including at 90% of the top 20 pharma companies
Crux Labs emerges from stealth with a $6M+ oversubscribed round co-led by Benchstrength and Misneach to align enterprise AI agents with expert human judgment

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Cisco patches a second actively exploited firewall VPN zero-day since August: CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6) in ASA and FTD Remote Access SSL VPN lets an unauthenticated remote attacker crash the device with a crafted request when secondary authentication is configured on a tunnel group

Gone in 20 minutes: hackers drain $6.3 billion from Binance in the largest crypto heist on record — about $3 billion frozen so far, losses covered by the exchange's user-protection fund, and analysts note similarities to the Bybit attack
Trezor warns customers who bought hardware wallets through reseller CryptoBilis since March to move funds immediately over a suspected hardware implant that could compromise private keys

The week's top 5 security stories are about assumptions nobody re-checked: GMO's trading-desktop cloud, a VMware ESXi flaw scored 2.7 exploited as a zero-day, a PeopleSoft trust-rule chain, an unrevoked key behind a poisoned LiteLLM release, and Dahua cameras reachable through the vendor's cloud

Cameroon warns fintech's rapid growth is drawing AI-enabled fraud and phishing, after 108 security audits of fintech firms found 3,914 vulnerabilities — weak access controls and poor data protection top the list

Overnight roundup: Binance dominates the window with a suspected $5.7–$6.3 billion theft, PHP2Shell and Brotli flaws keep turning up in real attacks, poisoned AI models and unpatched AI developer tools spread, and third-party leaks expose DHS staff and Japan Airlines passenger data
Kalshi closes a $1 billion Series G at a $40 billion valuation, co-led by Wellington and Sequoia — up 82% from $22 billion in May — as non-sports annualized revenue tops $1 billion

Chinese AI inference chip startup Nano-core raises over RMB 1 billion in a Series C2 round to fund product development and mass-production prep, with customer testing and initial shipments set for early 2027
Australian platform NonPublic channels $118 million into Tenstorrent's $1.5 billion Series E, valuing the RISC-V AI chipmaker at $6.2 billion and widening access to pre-IPO tech
Mistral opens the weights on trillion-parameter Mistral Large 4, a.k.a. Le Chonk, claiming the top open-weight coding score — while Alphabet and Microsoft report sharply different AI P&L stories
ADT agrees to go private in a $15.3 billion all-cash deal with Thrive Holdings at $10 a share, a 45.6% premium, with closing expected in Q1 2027 and data policies pledged unchanged

items.author: Wen-Yee Lee
items.headline: Foxconn flags a new OpenAI collaboration in the works after its chairman met Sam Altman, says there is no AI bubble, and expects double-digit growth next year as AI servers pass half its revenue

Binance sets aside more than $6.34 billion in company resources to restore customer balances after the $6.3 billion theft — $3 billion frozen with partners so far, withdrawals paused pending security checks
Bitcoin slides below $77,000 and over $1 billion in leveraged bets liquidate after the Binance theft, while Polymarket suspends international trading after hackers drain more than $2.6 million

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: CISA adds a CVSS-10 GitLab RCE and a Cisco firewall DoS flaw to its exploited-vulnerabilities list, giving federal agencies until November 1 to patch

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: WordPress Core RCE flaw patched October 28 draws nearly 63,000 attack attempts in 24 hours, Wordfence says — sites urged to update to 7.1.4

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Drupal warns a 'highly critical' Commerce Core authorization-bypass flaw is being actively exploited, letting attackers bypass access controls on store routes and fields
Cohere opens a financing targeting up to C$7 billion while AI engineering startup Dulo raises a $130 million seed backed by Eric Schmidt, John Doerr and DST Global
Travel firms told to stay vigilant as the PHP2Shell alert takes 30+ UK government sites offline — agents urged to confirm providers patched both flaws

Wall Street's AI-spending reckoning: the Nasdaq posts its biggest fall since June as Intel plunges 28.6% on a weak forecast and Alphabet's $51B-plus capex quarter erases $500B in a session — the index now down 7.8% from its October 6 high

What to know about the $6.3B Binance hack: attackers drained hot wallets on 10 blockchains in about 20 minutes, TRM Labs and Chainalysis point to North Korea's TraderTraitor, and the White House says US officials are investigating

Binance sets aside more than $6.34B in company funds to cover the heist — $5B already held in the same tokens stolen, the rest to be bought on public markets and over the counter, with about $3B frozen and withdrawals paused
Crypto liquidations hit $397.74M in 24 hours as Bitcoin trades near $77,000 — about 38.8% below its record high — and US spot Bitcoin ETFs post $643.33M in net outflows on Friday

items.author: Benjamin Read and Rami McCarthy
items.headline: Wiz names October ‘Black October’: at least nine AI developer platforms disclosed incidents this month — Fireworks AI to Northflank — with attackers hunting stored environment variables for AI keys, tested within 30 minutes and resold for LLMjacking

Nine AI dev platforms breached, keys resold: stolen model keys were tested within about 30 minutes and later resold, with two enterprise Bedrock abuses alone running up over $100k in list-price usage, per Wiz's October tally

October's patch ledger: PHP's exploited RCE pair, a Linux kernel flaw reachable over the network rated 9.8, and Microsoft's record 1,400-plus-vulnerability Patch Tuesday — with a second kernel race condition still awaiting fixes on most distros
China-nexus actors chained PHP2Shell with the Fragnesia Linux kernel flaw to gain root on Palo Alto firewalls and breach US government servers, Cybersecurity Dive reports
Funding week, October 24–30: manufacturing startup Re:Build closes $2.1B and Kalshi adds $1B at a $40B valuation, leading a roughly $4.8B week for US startups

OpenAI slashes its funding target by $10B to about $20B at a $1.25T valuation amid the tech rout, the FT reports — the first close is expected to raise less than $20B as some investors trim allocations

WordPress's upgrade-window RCE finally gets its CVE — CVE-2026-119977 — three days after the 7.1.4 patch, as Wordfence counts 60,000-plus blocked attempts and WordPress's own advisory rates the same bug Low

Binance says 90% of the $6.3B heist's assets are now replenished, up from 80% a day earlier, and it remains on track to resume withdrawals Sunday — customer BTC, ETH and eight other assets fully backed, with the shortfall in less liquid tokens still being bought

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Chainalysis confirms an attacker using 'offensive agentic techniques' broke into its systems and internal tools and accessed non-sensitive customer data — user IDs, full names, emails and organization role labels — while investigation content, credentials and session tokens stayed untouched

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: CISA adds two Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to its exploited-vulnerabilities list, completing a three-flaw chain — authentication bypass, code execution, privilege escalation — that gives unauthenticated root access; federal agencies must patch CVE-2026-111357 by Nov 2 and CVE-2026-118527 by Nov 13
DataWater's October edge-device recap counts twelve exploited edge products — Fortinet to Cisco ASA — with one federal deadline still open: Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418, due Sunday, November 1

A tampered Claude Code extension (2.1.312/2.1.313) served through Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours on Oct 29 planted an attacker SSH key and persistence, reaching up to 5,000 users; Sophos warns uninstalling alone leaves the backdoor in place
Crypto exchanges move to bolster defenses after the record $6.3B Binance heist, with Coinbase adjusting offline key storage and Tether freezing nearly $1.57B and Circle $800M linked to the theft

FBI confirms North Korea's TraderTraitor stole more than $6B from Binance and asks DeFi firms, exchanges and analytics providers to block 600-plus Ethereum addresses as the group converts the loot mainly into ether
Binance says BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC are now fully backed after replenishing 90% of the heist's assets, with withdrawals still targeted for Sunday

The November 1 daily brief ties the Binance attribution to a wider state-actor map: CrowdStrike says China-backed Vapor Panda used an agentic AI pentesting tool to compromise 140 sensitive targets in 11 days, and CISA's exploited list adds chained Ivanti and kernel flaws

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Cloudflare mitigated 18.2M network-layer DDoS attacks in Q3, up 38% from Q2 — about 8,226 an hour — as short-burst, sub-1 Gbps attacks surged 208% and hyper-volumetric attacks over 1 Tbps fell 69%

Reddit will gradually become a logged-in service, co-founder Steve Huffman says, testing mandatory sign-in in select markets outside the US to curb unauthorised scraping and personalise feeds — no real names or ID required

Cisco Talos finds the VOLTA infostealer sending a structured bundle of stolen data to an AI model to rank victims' assets and security posture, with a fallback chain across Claude Opus 4.6, Kimi K2 and Gemini 2.5 Flash
Microsoft seeks at least $25B in its first US bond sale since 2017 — ten tranches, two to 40 years — as quarterly capex tops $50B and its calendar-year AI buildout bill approaches $170B
OpenAI cuts its funding target by $10B to about $20B at a $1.25T valuation amid the tech rout, the FT reports, while Blackstone warns Anthropic may not earn an investment-grade rating after its IPO

items.author: Joe Robison
items.headline: OpenAI leads the Q4 2026 fastest-growing private tech ranking ahead of Kalshi and Anthropic, with 71 of the top 100 companies AI companies, scored on funding, traffic and branded search
Malicious code injected into Polymarket via a hijacked third-party page-speed script drained about $2.7M from signed-in traders' wallets; the platform says it is refunding all 726 affected wallets

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Kaspersky details NetamLoader, a previously undocumented .NET assembly-loading framework targeting a custom Windows 10 build used by government organizations in Asia, delivered inside a Windows cabinet archive in the OS update-packages directory

Polymarket says 689 of the 726 wallets hit by its supply-chain breach have been refunded in full, with the rest paid as claims are verified, plus $1.19M to about 5,500 wallets for losses during the trading halt, as Bitcoin holds near $78K

OneKey founder Yishi warns iPhone 11 and earlier models carry unpatchable BootROM flaws — checkm8 and the June-disclosed usbliter8 — that could expose wallet seed phrases to anyone who briefly holds the phone and uses a DFU-mode USB tool
Alibaba says its Qwen model enters Apple Intelligence in China with the iOS developer beta on November 4 and a public iOS 27.3 release planned for December

Fujitsu launches an incident-response service in Japan combining AI-driven rapid threat investigation with security-expert support, offering 24/7 forensic investigation to trace compromise and assess damage

items.author: Swati Khandelwal
items.headline: Critical flaw in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud (CVE-2026-112816, CVSS 10.0) lets an attacker log in as a trusted client without the client's private key, needing only network access to the HTTPS API and the trusted client's public certificate; fixed versions released

Malaysia Airlines says some customer information may have been affected by the Amadeus breach, joining Cathay Pacific and Japan Airlines, which reported 53,000 bookings and 92,000 customers affected; the airline says its own IT systems were not breached and no financial information was accessed

Northflank breach exposes developer AI keys: the cloud platform told customers to assume stored environment variables were decrypted after unauthorized use of AI API keys, tied by Wiz to October's nine-platform 'Black October' run

Binance hacker routes stolen Solana through Relay Protocol: the attacker's wallet moved about 486,970 SOL (~$46.4M) toward Bitcoin via cross-chain service Relay, part of a reported 970,522 SOL stash, as laundering continues after the FBI's TraderTraitor attribution

Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks — CVE-2026-111357 (8.8) and CVE-2026-118527 — completing the chain with October's auth bypass, as CISA sets a November 2 federal deadline for the privilege-escalation flaw
Apple sends a fresh round of mercenary-spyware threat notifications to users in 99 countries, its second major wave since August, as Germany's BSI warns lawmakers their iPhones may have been targeted

BTCPay Server tells operators to shut down their servers after reports of attackers draining merchants' bitcoin hot wallets, with early findings pointing to versions older than 2.4.2 where attackers logged in as admin

Radware traces a coordinated command-injection campaign that hit 61 public GitHub repos — LangExtract, Trivy, Brave, MLflow among them — hiding shell commands in issues and comments to run code inside Actions workflows and exfiltrate environment variables

A pre-auth RCE in TightVNC Viewer 2.8.88 lets a malicious server execute code before any password prompt, via a 32-bit integer wrap that turns a 4 GB framebuffer into a 128 KB allocation; fixed in 2.8.89 and 2.8.90
KnowBe4's Q3 report finds spear-phishing up 41.1% as attackers shift from mass campaigns to targeted identity attacks, with AI platforms the newest trusted infrastructure abused for lures
Abu Dhabi signs four OpenAI agreements spanning government, energy and investment — including a 'Machine-Readable Government' pilot already live on food imports — as Sam Altman meets the crown prince
UK photonics startup Salience Labs closes an oversubscribed $125M Series B led by Bullhound Capital to scale optical circuit switching for AI data centers
Foundry Robotics raises an oversubscribed $100M Series A led by Marlinspike Partners to build autonomous factories for complex assembly out of its 130,000-square-foot Emeryville plant
Beijing robot-training-data startup GenRobot AI discloses a $100M Series A+ from SAIC Motor, Baidu and others to scale equipment and software that collect human demonstrations for robot training
Munich startup Marble Cognition raises a $3.75M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Seedcamp to build AI 'coworkers' that learn a company by watching employees work

items.author: David DiMolfetta
items.headline: A US order purging Acronis products from federal civilian systems by January 27 stems from years of scrutiny over the firm's Russian development ties, sources say — the DHS directive was signed July 31 and only publicly posted last week
Bloomberg: North Korea's TraderTraitor used AI to hunt high-value crypto targets in the $6.3B Binance heist, laundering proceeds through about 12,000 wallets across 11 blockchains in under four days

items.author: Rae Wee, Elizabeth Howcroft
items.headline: Binance says customers pulled a net $4.7B since withdrawals reopened Sunday after the $6.3B hack — about 2.8% of platform assets — as the exchange says it covered losses from its treasury, insurance fund and security reserves

Funding Monday: Northwood Space leads with a $375M Series C at a $2B valuation, Hypersonica raises €100M for hypersonic missile technology, and India's Two Point O Capital adds $10M for clean-energy financing
Creandum closes its largest fund yet at $750M (Fund VIII, up from a €500M Fund VII) to back seed and Series A founders, with half the capital reserved for follow-on rounds

items.author: Daniel Levi
items.headline: OpenAI has secured only about $11B toward its $30B raise, cutting its target to $20B at a roughly $1.25T valuation, as investors balk at AI spending ahead of a planned 2027 IPO
Hackers claim a breach of personal data of 27 million Uzbek citizens and threaten a dark-web sale

Google and partners dismantle the XCPE botnet of more than 1.3M Android TV boxes, saying maker Videostrong deliberately built in a firmware backdoor and sold access to criminal affiliates — and ban the firm from certified Android devices

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: BTCPay Server says attackers exploited a flaw fixed in 2.4.2 to drain bitcoin and litecoin from hot wallets on servers running 2.4.1 or earlier, and urges operators to install the latest 2.4.7 release
Chainalysis puts the Mercado Bitcoin breach at about $49M across 17 chains, with nearly $10M frozen, while the exchange counts about $38M in assets involved and says customers will not suffer losses
South Korea's FSC holds an emergency meeting after the $6.3B Binance hack and asks local exchanges to raise cold-wallet shares, add incident-response staff and set aside extra reserves

Suspected cyberattacks hit supermarket refrigeration across Europe, with about 75 stores in Belgium affected alongside sites in Sweden, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands and Finland, forcing spoiled food to be discarded

Cathay Pacific says about 53,000 bookings were affected by unauthorized access to Amadeus reservation data between August 2023 and September 2026, mostly names, booking references and flight details, with no evidence payment data was accessed
Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal with a $115B implied enterprise value, giving Marvell holders about 67% of the combined company, with closing expected in the first half of 2028

items.author: Nate Russo
items.headline: Salesforce signs a definitive agreement to acquire voice-AI firm Cresta, reportedly for $2.7B, to fold its voice agents and real-time rep coaching into Agentforce and Service Cloud, with closing expected in fiscal Q1 2028

items.author: Nate Russo
items.headline: Larridin raises a $30M Series A led by Pelion Ventures to help enterprises track the operational return on AI spending, bringing its total funding to $47M
Portuguese AI startup Granter raises €1.6M led by 3XP Global to expand its AI platform for finding and managing European public funding beyond Portugal, lifting total funding to €2M
Neuron Industries raises a $10M seed round co-led by FCVC and Obvious Ventures to finish Cortex, an industrial controller engineers program in plain English, with first units expected in early 2027
SemiAnalysis launches GDPx, a benchmark scoring agentic models on paid work across 11 domains, with Anthropic's Opus 5.5 leading overall at 12% — and no model close to human-level performance
UK cyber agency NCSC warns AI-powered malware is 'highly likely' to feature in a ransomware attack on critical national infrastructure by 2028, in its State of the Cyber Nation report

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: ESET unmasks Gorbag, a Russia-aligned group harvesting credentials, VPN configs and documents from Ukrainian courts, police and front-line city councils since February 2025, lately via a WinRAR path-traversal flaw

items.author: Peter Zhang
items.headline: Binance's initial findings on its October 29 incident point to unauthorized access to an internal wallet-signing service and abuse of Ethereum's EIP-7702 delegation, with about $2.85B frozen or intercepted
Kraken restricts accounts linked to a suspected $133M theft from an unidentified EU entity, as North Korea denies involvement in the $6.3B Binance hack
Binance co-founder CZ warns AI is making hacking easier — tools now scan code for flaws far faster than people can — and says no platform has '100% security'
Three dozen business groups press Congress to renew the 2015 Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act for 10 more years before the latest extension lapses December 11, citing AI-accelerated threats
London-based Tallia raises €4M in seed funding co-led by Outward VC and ICAEW to bring AI-powered research and drafting to tax and accountancy firms
Tutor Intelligence raises $75M led by Andreessen Horowitz to expand its industrial robotics business, in a Nov 3 funding roundup led by Moffett AI's near-RMB 1B Series C+ and nPhase's $30M Series D

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Chainstack discloses a breach of production systems exposing customer data and password hashes, assessed as part of a large-scale AI-powered attack campaign

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: Attackers target an unpatched maximum-severity flaw in the CryptoPayment Gateway WordPress plugin that can expose wallet credentials
Binance says hackers used a bogus job interview and a tampered AI tool to compromise a wallet developer's computer before the $6.3B theft

Sekoia links Russia's APT29 to a watering-hole campaign using already-patched iOS and Android flaws to steal cookies, chat databases, credentials and photos from visitors to compromised sites — no click needed
CISA flags a high-severity WordPress Core race-condition flaw, CVE-2026-119977, as actively exploited and orders federal civilian agencies to patch by Friday

OPSSHIELD says attackers used stolen credentials to hijack cPGuard's update channel on November 2, pushing a backdoor and data-stealing script to versions 5.88.12–5.88.19; a spokesperson put affected servers at 2,946

Attackers chained PHP2Shell RCE flaws with a Linux kernel privilege-escalation bug to compromise 25 PAN-OS systems, including 24 perimeter firewalls, and tunnel into a US government-affiliated environment
Five vulnerabilities join CISA's exploited list this week as ransomware leak sites post 255 victims in seven days, with Thegentlemen claiming the most
Attackers reportedly reprogrammed French blood-service freezers from −30°C to 110°C, threatening critical plasma supplies, in a morning dominated by cold-chain attacks across Europe

Binance's account of the $6.3B heist: a five-month campaign from a fake recruiter and a tampered AI tool to drained hot wallets in minutes — with 95% of stolen tokens now replenished, says co-CEO Richard Teng

On-chain investigator ZachXBT names French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the suspected victim of a $133M crypto theft across Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX — a claim the bank has not confirmed beyond acknowledging fraudulent transactions
Chainalysis reports an AI-driven incident in which an external actor stole non-sensitive customer data, the latest hit in a wave of AI-powered attacks on crypto firms
AI inference startup Fal closes a $1.3B Series F led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation to $16B as demand for AI media generation keeps climbing
STATION F unveils its 2026 Future 40 — sovereign AI and physical AI lead the themes — as campus startups raise a record €2B this year
Canva cuts 1,271 roles, about 22% of its workforce, as growth slows and product work is reorganised; India's EloElo raises $80M in Series C

items.author: Swati Khandelwal
items.headline: Debian and Ubuntu patch an APT flaw, CVE-2026-109518, that lets a man-in-the-middle swap a verified package for a malicious one that then runs as root when APT retries a failed download

items.author: Swati Khandelwal
items.headline: Google's November Android bulletin patches 216 flaws, led by CVE-2026-58868, a critical zero-click Framework remote-code-execution flaw affecting Android 14 through 17; no in-the-wild exploitation reported

items.author: Ravie Lakshmanan
items.headline: SonicWall will not patch two flaws in end-of-life GMS 9.5.2 and earlier, including CVE-2026-109593, a 9.1-rated unauthenticated file-read flaw that could expose internal management files
Singapore Airlines says about 46,000 booking records may have been affected by the Amadeus breach, joining Cathay Pacific and Japan Airlines in disclosing customer data exposed

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirms it was hit by an attack enabling fraudulent transactions, saying the incident is now under control and retail clients face no financial impact — after ZachXBT put the suspected theft at $133M
BitMart confirms a November 2 breach of about $391,000, with its founder acknowledging funds moved to an address linked to the Mercado Bitcoin exploit
Traversal raises $120M for AI that diagnoses software outages as today's funding roundup totals about $1.62B across eight dollar rounds, plus Lingchuan's RMB 1B chip round

A CVSS 10.0 missing-authentication flaw in the Node-RED interface on Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced gateways, patched in August in Industrial OS V4.3.4.1, is now actively exploited, with VulnCheck observing exploitation from October 30 and 16 attempts by November 1

Qantas says Amadeus told it of unauthorized access to one of its systems, that the issue was contained in September, and that it is working with Amadeus to understand the impact on any Qantas bookings, with no impact to Qantas systems or databases

Coinbase says its customers are unaffected by the $6.34B Binance hack, with more than 99% of customer assets reportedly held in cold storage, plus distributed signing keys, withdrawal limits, unusual-activity detection and controls that can stop transaction signing
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa says about €100M is missing after this week's cyberattack, and it cannot yet say how much it will recover — while customer accounts were untouched
CISA adds a WebKit flaw Apple patched 18 months ago, CVE-2024-27834, to its exploited list after Sekoia ties it to an APT29 watering-hole campaign hitting unpatched iPhones and Androids
Hypersonica raises a €100M Series B for hypersonic missiles as Pliant banks $80M to let AI agents move money
OPSShield says a hijacked cPGuard update channel pushed a root-level backdoor to about 2,950 Linux hosting servers and exposed 7,900 billing records
OpenAI says an autonomous pipeline found and validated 948 Linux kernel root exploits — with a patch drafted for each — in a single $1.2M run

items.author: Toby Sterling, Dimitri Rhodes, Hakan Ersen
items.headline: AI is sharpening the cat-and-mouse hacking battle, from hacked supermarket fridges to a record Binance theft, as companies rush to strengthen defences
Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, the company says — just four rides in its busiest week, against 320M trips and orders
OpenAI plans to acquire Pierre Computer, whose code-storage service and Trees and Diffs libraries already power Codex, in a shot at GitHub
Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor, whose parallel agent workspaces run on Anthropic and OpenAI models — and its cloud service shuts down November 20

items.author: Anhata Rooprai, Stephen Nellis
items.headline: Qualcomm shares slide as weak smartphone chip sales overshadow its data-center push, with handset revenue down 26%
Zyxel patches a GS1900 zero-day, CVE-2026-107441, that hackers used to compromise 996 switches in 48 countries and steal configs and hashed root passwords
OpenSSH issues an emergency fix for a flaw letting long passwords bypass SSH auth on Alpine Linux
Zyxel's earlier GS1900 patch fails to block the zero-day exploit, Binarly finds, as the vendor ships new firmware for 10 switch models
Hacktivist groups claim Nov. 5 breaches at Philippine government agencies, including a claimed 19.2M-record PhilJobNet haul — none of the claims independently verified
US bank regulators checked in with banks after the $6.3B Binance heist, asking about unusual activity and disruptions, Reuters reports
Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure, its largest deal yet, backing a new DBX Agent Cloud storage platform
Mistral AI buys SkipLabs, its fifth acquisition of 2026, adding tools to make AI code generation faster and more reliable
ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud, with 25M tracks already made on its models
CISA confirms active exploitation of GitLab's maximum-severity CVE-2026-97229, and Alpine Linux rebuilds its GitLab after an exploitation attempt

items.author: Nick Harris
items.headline: New extortion group Whitearmor lists Unilever on its leak site with a $15M demand, claiming 79GB of data — Unilever has not confirmed a breach
Node2Shell: a critical Brotli decoder flaw, CVE-2026-111497, rated CVSS 9.2, could allow remote code execution across Node.js, .NET and other platforms
The Zyxel switch attacks first blamed on a patched flaw actually ran on the new zero-day, CVE-2026-107441, Binarly finds — hitting nearly 1,000 switches
The $6.3B Binance heist is prompting insurers to scrutinize crypto firms’ security more closely, Reuters reports — no available policy could cover a loss that size
AI inference startup Fal raises $1.3B at a $16B valuation, doubling its value — Bessemer leads, with Nvidia, Sound Ventures and T. Rowe Price in
OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, a security-specialized model that finds vulnerabilities and builds exploits to test defenses — restricted at first to selected Daybreak Red organizations
Google tells schools they can turn Gemini off — but then students lose Search too, with no AI-free search option on offer
Sentra raises a $150M Series C led by Capital One Ventures to protect corporate data from AI agents, after 300% year-on-year growth
Chainalysis traces laundering of the stolen Binance funds to Chinese networks, with nearly $1B already moving — about $500M of it through TRON
Chainalysis now says password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed, a week after first saying only names and emails were taken — KYT restarts in phases, Reactor stays offline
New York insurtech Kalepa raises $75M at a ~$470M valuation for AI insurance underwriting
Meta opens Muse Voice to all US users, letting them call and video chat with its AI agent’s animated avatar on mobile, web and Mac
